{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print(df[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].duplicated().sum())

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
# This ensures we have only one row per patient, with the latest measurement
# Use groupby and idxmax to select the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the number of unique patients
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_clean)}")

# Confirm the columns
print(df_clean.columns)

# Check the unique values in severity
print(df_clean['severity'].value_counts())"}
